[HyperCaptive Filtration System] Combination of a HEPA Filter, Carbon Filter, Washable Filter effectively reduces 99.97% of 0.3-micron particles in the air, including pollen, pollutants, and other allergens. It also reduces 99% of volatile organic compounds and odor.

[Cartridge Design] Some purifiers make a dusty mess when trying to replace or clean your filters. With Coway's cartridge design, it's easier and cleaner than ever to remove and replace filters since they are contained in one portable cartridge.
[Easy Touch Display] You have control with a touch of a button-including fan speed, power, light on/off, and filter reset.
[Auto Mode] Constantly monitoring the air quality, the fan automatically adjusts to most effectively purify your space as needed providing a new level of clean in real time.
[3-Stage Manual Fan Speed] Control your Airmega 150's fan manually with low, medium, and high settings.

[Air Quality Indicator] Pollution sensor communicates indoor air quality in real-time. Brightly colored LED lets you know how clean or dirty your indoor air is every minute of the day. You can turn off the light for sleeping.
[Filter Alerts] The air filter indicator tells you when the filters need to be replaced, and the pre-filter needs to be cleaned for maximum efficiency, based on how much air they have processed.
[Ultra Quiet] Ultra quiet operation with noise levels ranging from 19 dB to 48 dB.
[Warranty] 3-year Limited Manufacturer's Warranty
description: 1.Airmega Air Purifiers, tested by KCL(Korea Conformity Laboratories), demonstrate effective capture of 0.01㎛ ultra-fine particles and allergens according to Korea Air Cleaning Association standards (SPS-KACA 002-132:2022 Modified). Performance may vary in your environment. 2.Our HEPA filter complies with IEST-RP-CC007 standards at speed level 1 as tested by SGS (Société Générale de Surveillance). SGS's test report only reflects SGS's evaluation of the sample and does not reflect the evaluation of the batch of goods from which the sample was taken. 3.Tested for acetic acid reduction rate by KCL(Korea Conformity Laboratories) in a chamber under JEM 1467: 2015 conditions for 60 minutes. Results may vary in different environments. 4.Activated Carbon Filter was tested by KCL(Korea Conformity Laboratories) and shown to reduce various harmful gases and odors within 30 minutes, including key VOCs and pollutants. Results are based on lab conditions and may differ in actual use. 5.Allergen filter media was tested by Nichinichi Pharmaceutical to measure allergen concentration using ELISA over a 24-hour reaction period. The test reflects the filter media's performance under laboratory conditions and results may vary in actual product usage environments. 6.Tested reduction rate of ammonia and hydrogen sulfide for 30 minutes under EL608:2023 condition by KCL(Korea Conformity Laboratories). Results may vary in different environments. 7. Tested by Intertek, reduction rates of Naphthalene, Sulfur Dioxide, and Nitrogen Dioxide were tested following JEM-1467:2015 standards. Actual performance may vary depending on the living environment. 9.Tested by KCL(Korea Conformity Laboratories) according to SPS-KACA002-132:2022. The test was conducted with Methyl mercaptan, Isovaleraldehyde, Isovaleric acid in a 1.0±0.1 m3 chamber with a test time of 60 minutes at (24±4)°C and (46±10)% Relative Humidity. A removal ratio of over 99.5% was achieved. Results may vary depending on the actual usage environment. 10.Tested by the Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology, exposed the filter media to protein solutions for 24 hours under ISO 4333-2022 standard. The results showed strong reduction performance: >99.79% for pollen, >99.60% for dog allergen, >99.90% for cat allergen, and >99.80% for dust mites matter allergen. Actual results may vary depending on room size, airflow, and pollutant levels. 11.Tested by KCL(Korea Conformity Laboratories) according to SPS-KACA002-132:2022. The test was conducted in a 1.0±0.1 m³ chamber for 60 minutes at (24±4)°C and (46±10)% Relative Humidity. A removal ratio of >99.5% was achieved for Formaldehyde and Toluene in 60 minutes. Results may vary depending on the actual usage environment. 12.Tested by Intertek, the test was conducted in a 1.0 m³ chamber for 120 minutes resulting a 99.9% removal rate on sulfur dioxide, nitrogen dioxide, and naphthalene. Results may vary depending on the actual usage environment.
review_excerpts: This is my third brand of air purifier I have purchased. I got these two on a Black Friday deal! I love these things so much. They are an absolute BREEZE to clean. You just vacuum out the prefilter every two weeks (or rinse it if it gets too gross) Filter replacement is easy peasy! You do have to buy a deodorizing filter every six months and a HEPA filter every year per the instruction manual. But you can buy a multipack of them for cost savings (the one I bought will last at least two years if I change the filters on time-I am a little bit of a procrastinator though I admit) The best part of these is that they are really responsive to the purifying needs of the room! Once I was dusting above it and it sensed the dust and went full power on its own! I was floored. It has an indicator light

We recently moved to the city into a tiny apartment with a large dog that sheds heavily. I don't usually have allergies but noticed that I started sneezing a ton more in this new living situation. I did a bit of research on air purifiers and settled on this one primarily because of the price and the way it looks. I wanted something that was visually unobtrusive. I have been very happy with how this purifier has worked out for us. We've definitely notices an improvement in the air quality in our apartment. It has eliminated all of the sneezing I was experiencing. It is quiet in it's low and medium settings, and sounds like a fan on the highest setting. I leave it on auto mode and it really only kicks into high gear when the dog lays on her bed (right next to the purifier) or when we're cook

I previously had a nice-looking, "smart" Mila air purifier. It was fine as an air purifier, but it was very expensive, and the "smart" features kept disconnecting. So, when it finally stopped working, I decided to replace it with an air purifier that's relatively simple. However, I wanted something that still matched the aesthetic of my apartment. This Coway 150 seemed to fit! Love the look of it, and it does a pretty job purifying, as well. Cooking? The purifier starts running. Open the hallway door? The purifier starts running. I feel better about the air quality in my apartment while also being happy about how it looks.

I bought this to purify the air in our master bedroom. We're in a newly built home and it's sealed up tight. The bedroom tends to smell musty after we shower and smells linger in from the adjacent kitchen. This was priced reasonably for the size and it's really cleaned the air well. No more musty smell after a day of use. It does tell us that the air quality is poor if we run the oil diffuser nearby or spray any aerosols in the room so it's picking up the particulates in the air. Pretty quiet when on the lowest setting. The highest setting annoys me so we only use that when we're not in the room. Easy to pull out the outer filter and wipe off.. Ours had a very very light coating of dust after 2 weeks of use. Haven't looked at the filter yet. The blue light on top can be bright art night bu

I want one of these in every room! I turn it on when I’m cooking and it quickly removes all the smell even bacon smoke! Quickly gets rid of cooking odors and has made a big difference in the pollen on the inside of my house. Super quiet on 1 and 2. 3 is a little noisy but still not too much! It’s easy to clean and is super nice quality.

Couldn’t be happier. I have two cats and a dog. I bought three of these for different areas of the house. I have to wipe the cat hair off the front of the unit that gets sucked in and clean the pre-filter once every two weeks so I know it’s working. I also bought one of the smaller units for a different area of the house. I love the indicator light that shows the air quality.  It’s pretty quiet. The air quality indicator is red, and it turns on full blast, but it only stays on for about a minute and then slowly reduces the speed as it cleans the air.

Given the retail price and the smaller form factor, I figured I'd give the Coway Airmega 150 a shot. I use the Mighty (AP-1512HH) as my purifier for my  bedroom, but the high power and ability to move air seemed overkill given the small 12x12 space. After receiving the Airmega 150, I was pleasantly surprised at the quality and attention to detail. The aesthetic and design is perfect, however the footprint was not as small as I had hoped, even though I read the measurements. Essentially its about the same as the Mighty, but 3" less in depth. That means it will sit more flush to a wall, but likely not enough to save space. Regardless, I was happy to have something with less airflow, better suited for my bedroom. This is where I was a bit underwhelmed. When on setting 1, the fan is whisper qu

I've had this air purifier for a few weeks and I like it a lot. I noticed a difference the first day I had it. It's not noisy and I don't even notice the light at night. There is an option to turn off as well if that's something you'd like to be able to do. title: BLUEAIR Blue Pure 511i Max Smart Air Purifier for Bedroom & Small Rooms up to 926 Sq Ft, HEPASilent Air Cleaner for Pets, Allergies, Smoke & Dust, Quiet WiFi Air Purifier with Auto Mode
bullets: Powerful Air Cleaning for Small Rooms: The Blue Pure 511i Max quickly refreshes indoor air in bedrooms, nurseries, home offices, and apartments. It cleans 193 sq ft in about 12.5 minutes, 465 sq ft in 30 minutes, and up to 926 sq ft in one hour.

Removes Dust, Smoke, Pet Dander & Allergens: Blueair’s HEPASilent dual filtration technology captures 99.97% of airborne particles down to 0.1 microns, including dust, pollen, pet dander, mold particles, and smoke.
Quiet Air Purifier for Bedrooms: Designed for sleep-friendly performance, the purifier operates as quietly as 19 dB, making it ideal for bedrooms, nurseries, and dorm rooms.

Smart Air Purifier with App Control: Built-in air quality sensors automatically adjust fan speed when pollution levels rise. Use the Blueair mobile app to monitor air quality, control settings, and receive filter replacement reminders.

Compact Design for Modern Homes: The Blue Pure 511i Max features a compact Scandinavian-inspired design with 360° air intake, allowing it to fit easily in small rooms while efficiently circulating clean air.
description: The Blueair Blue Pure 511i Max smart air purifier is designed for bedrooms, small rooms, and apartments that need efficient air cleaning. Using advanced HEPASilent™ filtration technology, it captures 99.97% of airborne particles including dust, pollen, pet dander, and smoke, helping improve indoor air quality. Capable of cleaning up to 926 square feet in one hour, the Blue Pure 511i Max is ideal for bedrooms, nurseries, home offices, and homes with pets or allergy concerns. Experience powerful air purification in a compact design with the Blueair Blue Pure 511i Max smart air purifier, engineered for bedrooms and small living spaces. The purifier combines mechanical and electrostatic filtration through Blueair’s proprietary HEPASilent™ technology, capturing airborne pollutants such as dust, pollen, pet dander, smoke particles, and mold spores while maintaining quiet operation. This advanced filtration captures particles down to 0.1 microns, helping keep indoor air cleaner and fresher. Designed for small spaces, the Blue Pure 511i Max refreshes indoor air quickly, cleaning 193 square feet in about 12.5 minutes or up to 926 square feet in one hour. review_excerpts: Nice and quiet

I have been using this for several months now and it works great! It's made very well, and it looks good sitting on my shelf in my bedroom. The blue light looks nice at night as well. I just took the filter out to clean it tonight, and it was very easy to clean. You just take it out of the bottom, I used a soft brush to clean the dust off the cylinder, which has a screen around the actual filter, which keeps the dust on the outside of the filter so the dust doesn't get all through the actual filter, so it lasts a long time. I've only cleaned it once since I bought it, and after I brushed it off, it still looks and works like brand new. I’ve been using this in our bedroom, and it does a great job at quietly cleaning the air, you can barely hear it running, even at night. The aromatherapy feature is a bit disappointing, you can’t really smell the essential oil at all, so I’m not sure why it’s even included. On the bright side, the controls are simple, and the white design blends easily with the room décor. Works well and does a good job. Easy to turn on and off. Has a quiet mode where you cannot hear it running. Actually don't mind the faster speeds as it helps relax me to sleep. review_excerpts: Pros: - Does a wonderful job at clearing the air. My apartment does not have a range hood for evacuating cooking smoke, and would often create a haze in my apartment. This powerhouse will recognize the bad air quality quickly and scrub out all the smoke caused by cooking. I purchased a Dyson in parallel to see which I would rather keep, and the 250s actually kept purifying after the Dyson noted “good” air quality. I could tell there was still a bit of smoke and cooking odor, and couldn’t understand why the Dyson didn’t recognize what this unit did. - Great coverage for a unit this size. I previously looked at smaller units to tuck away out of sight, but would have needed 3-4 to cover the area this unit does. - The fan doesn’t have a buzzing of mechanical sound to it, more of a “whooshing”

Instead of buying knock off filters I did my research on who makes air purifiers built to last. The popular Coway models have been around for 8+ years and they still sell them. I’ve been very pleased with this machine. What I like: The app! Some people report troubles connecting it to their home network. I’ve had no issues, I use Eero and it setup the first try flawlessly. Design: it’s much better to look at than any other air purifier I considered especially in its price range. Scheduler: I like that I can tell it to go to sleep at a set time every night and to turn the lights off. As well as when I’d like it to switch back to smart mode a

Looks so good in our space. Is nice and quite, works with smart home for scheduling super easy and has noticeably made a difference with our dust. I rotate it around our 1200sqft apartment for maximum efficiency. Sensor light may be meh but the research I did told me that most are, doesn’t effect the quality of the filter 🙌

I was excited to get this. I've done extensive research and this product was listed in the top three recommendations for air purifiers. For background, I have severe allergies to tree pollen, dust, pets, etc. I have a rabbit air purifier that will clean out a room of everything in just a few hours. I had a feral outdoor cat spraying my house and the smell was getting inside - even after clean up, the smell lingered. The rabbit was my saving grace and removed all that odor. It does an amazing job with pet dander and dust, too. It kept my allergies to a mininum. But because of the price, I couldn't afford a second one... But I really needed another air purifier for the front end of my house, as that would be my temporary bedroom while family stays with me, so I opted to buy this, while I kep
Product seems to work pretty well cleaning the air. It's a little loud went it ramps up to it's highest setting. Connecting it to the app is hit and miss.

so heres the deal. these things work great. I am a smoker, and you literally cant tell by coming in my house. I tell people that I smoke in my house and they dont believe me. Camel Wides. These things are one of the best purchases I have made. they hook up to Alexa easily. their smart mode is great and there is even an option to turn the light off on the unit. they probably will work for 900 sq feet as advertised. I have two in my house of 1200 sq feet at other ends, but I think one would have been good enough. I strongly recommend you purchase these. the air is just so much cleaner. They have a prefilter that you can wash and you are supposed to do that like once a month and it takes like 10 seconds. the HEPA filter you are supposed to do once a year, but I have been thoroughly rinsing it

Hate to leave three stars but the app is really bad. Signs out daily, took an hour of fussing to get the WiFi working initially. When unplugged, it forgets the WiFi and you have to set it up all over again. Would give Five stars if the UX wasn’t so terrible.

When the air quality is poor it sounds like a plane during take off, but it gets the job done quickly and the app gives me real time updates about the small (e.g. smoke) vs larger air particles (e.g. dust) needing to be filtered. I can turn off all of the lights while still using the filter overnight so it's not bright at all. Sleep mode is really quiet.

review_excerpts: Great product.  Works well.  It has cut down on the pet fur and dust in my 15x20 room.  Pay attention to the dimensions.  It's not a tiny.  It looked smaller to me so I almost didn't get it as I wanted a larger purifier.  So the size is exactly what I wanted / expected.  It's not silent but it's pretty quiet to me.  Again, no surprise for me as I checked the db rating first.

I bought this and another product because my husband and FIL has really bad spring-summer allergies. It worked SO WELL. The design is great, doesnt take much space and can put in the corner. It is not loud unless you use it at it's full strength, but it sounds like the wind, not a machine made sound. Air quality and cleanliness, AMAZING. My husband and I tested by, yes, farting next to it. It cleared up so fast. Absolutely worth the investment and I bought 2 more (on sale, cant afford full price) for my family because they are allergic to everything and their pets are also allergic to Texas pollen.

This little guy works incredibly well. We don’t have a true exhaust vent over our stove, and got this to sit on the fridge and manage whatever the recirculating vent built in to the over-the-range microwave can’t handle. We leave it on the automatic setting and it does a great job ramping up while we cook and then going back to the low setting once the air is cleared. I like that you can turn off the status indicator lights, and being able to just hit the auto button means it’s easy to use, no fiddling with settings. It takes care of strong cooking odors and was worth every penny. We also have two other Coway air filters and they have lasted several years so far without any problems.

Small but effective, Put this in my bedroom. I got this because some people who visit my home is allergic to pet hair , works great and they barely sneeze like before and they are more comfortable. I just got the airway mega 100 for my living room.

I purchased these two units mid January 2026. I didn’t expect to be replacing the filters in less than six months. It’s only been five months, and the replacement indicator has already come on. I run both one upstairs and one downstairs 24/7 on setting 1 in auto mode, and they are very quiet. Occasionally, when we cook bacon or popcorn, the unit ramps up and changes color from blue to green, indicating it’s working—I love it. This unit definitely works. The lingering smell of bacon throughout the day is gone, and the usual stale household odors we had before are no longer an issue since this unit. I didn’t realize how dirty the filter had become until I compared it side by side with a new one (see photo). It’s just my husband and me, both in our 60s, living in a 1,300 sq ft home with no pe

Coway has always been a winner in my home, so i bought this for my apartment.  I'm impressed with how much gets collected, well, maybe that's the wrong word, as it ought to be depressed by it!  It means there's a lot of dust and such in the place that needs filtering! I would recommend these units in kids' bedrooms, near the kitchen for the smells of cooking that can be irritating to those of us with certain sensitivities. Coway's emit little sound, the are easy to do filter changs, and if the little lights bother you, put masking tape over it!  I find it a good tiny night light for middle of the night wake ups that require some navigation from the bedroom.
I love this Air purifier. I use it in the bedroom but also my living space. The dust has decreased dramatically and my breathing is easier. Its worth the money.

Decent value but the build quality holds it back. Coway is a known brand and the coverage area up to 810 sq ft is solid for the price, but once you have it in hand the plastic feels cheap and hollow — not what I expected from this brand. The HEPA and carbon filter combo does work well. Handles dust, pet dander, and cooking smells without issue, and I noticed cleaner air within a day. description: 1.Airmega Air Purifiers, tested by KCL(Korea Conformity Laboratories), demonstrate effective capture of 0.01㎛ ultra-fine particles and allergens according to Korea Air Cleaning Association standards (SPS-KACA 002-132:2022 Modified).
